content_sections.heading: EIL Associate Engineer Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for EIL Associate Engineer Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the required educational qualification and relevant post qualification experience mentioned in the notification. Candidates should have relevant experience as Planning Engineer with expertise in Primavera P6, MS Project or similar tools along with proficiency in MS Office. Experience in Engineering Office and Field Office in PMC, EPCM and EPCC projects in Oil & Gas, Fertilizer or Power Plant fields is required. Candidates should also have experience in Planning and Scheduling activities related to engineering, procurement, logistics, site installation and construction functions. Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India guidelines for eligible categories. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

faq.question: Q1. What is EIL Associate Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: EIL Associate Engineer Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive by Engineers India Limited for engaging experienced engineers on a fixed term basis for Project Controls, Planning & Scheduling.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in EIL Associate Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 15 Associate Engineer vacancies are available.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for EIL Associate Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 29 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for EIL Associate Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have B.E./B.Tech./B.Sc (Engineering) in Civil, Mechanical, Industrial or Production Engineering with minimum 60% marks or equivalent CGPI along with required experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for EIL Associate Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 37 years for Associate Engineer Grade II and 41 years for Associate Engineer Grade III.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of EIL Associate Engineer?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration ranges from ₹72,000 to ₹80,000 for Associate Engineer Grade II and ₹86,400 to ₹96,000 for Associate Engineer Grade III depending on city category.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for EIL Associate Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates will be selected through screening and personal interview.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for EIL Associate Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply through online registration on the Engineers India Limited website and attend the walk-in interview with required documents.
